headline: Renames a Postal Service building in Miami, Arizona, after Staff Sergeant Manuel V. Mendoza.
what_it_does: This law names the Postal Service facility at 161 Live Oak Street in Miami, Arizona, the Staff Sergeant Manuel V. Mendoza Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
